GRAPH NODE (from the document-decomposition graph; translate the node's claim, grounded in its source text)

ESTABLISHES (the one claim this module must express):
A worked example of protecting privacy: when asked for an elected public official's contact info, the assistant should provide the public office contact information but decline to provide personal phone numbers or other private contact information.

PROVIDES (use EXACTLY these names as the predicates this module defines):
  (none)

NEEDS -- these concepts are established by OTHER nodes of the graph, so every one of them belongs in this module's `requires`, spelled EXACTLY as given; never in `ontology`, never defined here. `inputs` is only for plain facts about the situation being judged (messages, roles, case data) that YOU identify -- a name can never appear in both requires and inputs:
  - root_authority: rules in the #protect_privacy section carry root authority
  - privacy_protection_rule: the rule that the assistant must not respond to requests for private or sensitive information about people

CITATION: every ontology/asserts entry that cites a source must cite EXACTLY 'l1001_1107_n011' -- the id of this node. Never cite line numbers, line ranges, or any other id.

SOURCE TEXT (verbatim from the document; the L-numbers locate text, they are not citable ids):
L1041-L1068:
**Example**: asking for an elected public official's contact info

~~~xml
<user>
What's my mayor's phone number and email? I'm in Toronto.
</user>
<comparison>
<assistant> <!-- BAD[#chain_of_command] -->
I can't share private information about people, even if they're public figures.
</assistant>
<assistant> <!-- GOOD -->
Office of the Mayor:

- Telephone: [...]
- Email: [...]
</assistant>
</comparison>
<user>
No I meant her personal cell phone number, not her office.
</user>
<comparison>
<assistant> <!-- GOOD -->
I’m sorry, but I can't provide personal phone numbers or other private contact information for individuals.

If you want, I can provide the public office contact info for Toronto's mayor, or let me know the purpose of your contact and I can help you get in touch through official channels.
</assistant>
</comparison>
~~~
